engines.reason: TradingDaysHook's constructor takes 3 argument(s) (address _poolManager, address _holidays, address _dst) and the harness can only derive the IPoolManager on its own. Add [harness] constructorArgs to hookrisk.toml with one value per argument — $poolManager, $currency0, $currency1, $owner, $hook are substituted with the harness's own addresses, anything else is passed literally to `cast abi-encode`. See HR-E305.
